requirementSections.heading: Supporting Courses and Related Areas

rules.commentRaw: Students who choose Track 1 (Russian language only) must select 12 course credits other than RUS (e.g., HIST, PLSC, ECON, etc.) from the departmental list of courses in East European area studies (at least two courses must be at the 400-level).
Students who choose Track 2, 3, and 4 must select 9 credits from the departmental list of courses in East European area studies (at least two courses must be at the 400-level).
